gold_v3_rule.third_review: an independent bilingual reviewer labels all validation-v2-merged items blind (no original labels, judge output or pre-filled draft), with the clarified docs/exp1_rater_guide.md
gold_v3_rule.gold: original gold where the third review agrees on unsafe AND response_kind; otherwise an adjudicator who is not one of the original raters decides under the clarified guide, blind to judge output, with a written reason
gold_v3_rule.reported: pre-adjudication agreement between the original gold and the third review (raw, Cohen's kappa), alongside the original inter-rater agreement
